title: Replication
summary: How the server's world state reaches clients: containers like ReplicatedStorage replicate automatically, property changes propagate, and clients receive copies (with streaming!). Replication is asynchronous — timing bugs come from forgetting that.

verification.notes: See Roblox docs on replication and streaming for authoritative details.

explanation.whatItIs: The automatic pipeline copying (parts of) the server's DataModel to every client — objects, property changes, and removals — without you writing network code.
explanation.whyItExists: Clients need a world to render. Roblox ships the server's version down automatically, piece by piece.
whenToUse: Place shared content in replicating containers (ReplicatedStorage) or workspace
Keep secrets OUT of replicated containers (ServerStorage/SSS stay server-only)
Expect arrival delays on clients — WaitForChild bridges them
Remember streaming may unload far-away content on clients (StreamingEnabled)
whenNotToUse: As a substitute for explicit messages — gameplay events go through remotes
For data that shouldn't reach clients at all
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
SERVER DataModel                    CLIENTS
 ReplicatedStorage ─────auto──────▶ copies arrive (async!)
 ServerStorage     ─────✗ never
 workspace changes ─────auto──────▶ property updates

Client code must tolerate: 'not here yet' / 'streamed out'.
```
tips: WaitForChild on the client for anything replicated
StreamingEnabled: use WaitForChild around player-local content or set streaming-friendly patterns
Frequent property changes replicate — but don't use replication as a high-bandwidth channel
commonMistakes: Assuming replicated content exists when a LocalScript starts
Storing secrets in ReplicatedStorage/workspace — clients (and exploiters) read all of it
Client-side changes expected to reach the server — client edits stay client-local

examples.title: Timing-safe client access
examples.code:
-- LocalScript: content may arrive AFTER we start
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SharedModules", 10)
assert(modules, "SharedModules never replicated")

local config = require(modules:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
print("Config loaded:", config.RoundLength)
